Indictment doubles the number of charges ‌faced by Thomas Markle, 82
Thomas Markle, the estranged father of ‌the Duchess of Sussex, Meghan Markle was indicted on Tuesday in ​U.S. federal court ⁠in ⁠Los ‌Angeles on two counts of possessing child sexual abuse ⁠material.

The indictment doubles the number of charges ‌the 82-year-old Markle faces in the case, in which ​he is accused ⁠of posing in photographs with ⁠at least ⁠one ⁠naked ​underage girl and with ​other children in ⁠various stages of undress.
It follows last Thursday's ruling by a judge in Florida that Markle is mentally competent to face a federal charge of possession of child pornography filed earlier this month.

blocks.text: In an October statement, Meghan Markle, an American citizen who starred in the U.S. television drama Suits, married Prince Harry at Windsor Castle in 2018 and had two children with him, said she was "deeply distressed" by the allegations.
She also revealed that a letter containing allegations about him had been sent to London police in 2019.
"It made troubling and disturbing allegations against my father and I was given assurances that these were being investigated," Meghan said of the letter.

"I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications' distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children was for one reason: to protect them."
With files from The Associated Press
